title: Physically Aware Radiomics Without Interpolation: Disentangling Voxel Geometry and Signal Modification in CT and MRI
abstract: arXiv:2607.12399v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Objective: Radiomic texture features are usually computed in voxel-index neighborhoods, implicitly assuming isotropic spatial relationships. In anisotropic images, this can confound voxel geometry with interpolation-induced signal changes. We developed a voxel-spacing-aware radiomic framework that incorporates physical geometry into texture computation without resampling.   Approach: We modified PyRadiomics to account for voxel spacing while preserving the native image signal. Four configurations were compared: native non-resampled extraction (NR), isotropic resampling (RS), voxel-spacing-aware extraction (VS), and fake-isotropic preprocessing (FK), in which spacing metadata were overwritten without altering the image array. Experiments included 685 LIDC-IDRI pulmonary nodules and 209 I-SPY2 breast MRI cases, with 196 radiomic descriptors. translated_title: 无插值的物理感知放射组学：解耦CT和MRI中的体素几何与信号修改
translated_abstract: 目标：放射组学纹理特征通常在体素索引邻域中计算，这隐含地假设了各向同性的空间关系。在各向异性图像中，这种方法可能将体素几何与插值引起的信号变化相混淆。我们开发了一个体素间距感知的放射组学框架，在不进行重采样的情况下将物理几何纳入纹理计算。方法：我们修改了PyRadiomics，使其能够考虑体素间距，同时保留原始图像信号。研究比较了四种配置：原生非重采样提取（NR）、各向同性重采样（RS）、体素间距感知提取（VS），以及伪各向同性预处理（FK，即覆盖间距元数据但不改变图像数组）。实验涵盖685个LIDC-IDRI肺结节和209个I-SPY2乳腺MRI病例，共196个放射组学描述符。鲁棒性通过组内相关系数（ICC）、受试者内变异性、Friedman检验和特征选择等方法进行评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需重采样的体素间距感知放射组学框架，通过修改PyRadiomics将物理几何信息纳入纹理特征计算，从而在各向异性CT和MRI图像中避免插值对图像信号的干扰。
